SELECT TNA.*,TT.ORGNAME auditOrgName,TS.REALNAME auditStaffName,STAFF.REALNAME auditUserName,PJ.PRJOECTNAME projectName FROM TBL_NBSJ_CERTIFICATE TNA LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF STAFF ON STAFF.STAFFID = TNA.AUDITUSERID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT PJ ON PJ.projectId =TNA.projectId LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION TT ON PJ.AUDITORGID =TT.ORGID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF TS ON PJ.AUDITSTAFFID = TS.STAFFID WHERE 1=1
AND PJ.projectId =#{tblNbsjCertificateVo.projectId}
AND PJ.PRJOECTNAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{tblNbsjCertificateVo.projectName}),'%')
AND TNA.auditMatter LIKE concat(concat('%',#{tblNbsjCertificateVo.auditMatter}),'%')
AND TNA.auditAbstract LIKE concat(concat('%',#{tblNbsjCertificateVo.auditAbstract}),'%')
ORDER BY TNA.CERTIFICATEID
